{{Top|leg}}
'''Much Regret Unable''' was the [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#M|phrase]] used by the forces of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to indicate that they were unable to perform new orders due to being too deeply engaged in their current mission.
